in_hebrew.name: מרית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'marah', meaning 'bitterness' or 'sorrow'. This name may be derived from the story of Marah the Bitterness, a place where the Israelites grumbled and complained to Moses, but was later provided with water by God.

in_greek.name: Μαρίτα
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'maria', meaning 'rebellious'. This name may be derived from the Maries mentioned in the New Testament, such as Mary Magdalene or Mary of Bethany.

in_latin.name: Maria
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'maria', which is derived from the Greek 'maria' and ultimately from the Hebrew 'marah'. This name has been very popular in the Latin world, with many famous Marias throughout history, including the Virgin Mary.
